name: Civmec Limited
summary: Civmec Limited, an investment holding company, provides construction and engineering services to the energy, resources, infrastructure, marine, and defense sectors in Australia. The company undertakes fabrication projects, such as structural steel, plateworks, naval vessels, tanks, materials handling equipment, subsea and offshore structures, and pipe spooling services.
